sources.title: Spiritual Machines: The Merging of Man and Machine — Ray Kurzweil

sourceCaveat: The original book edition has not been independently checked. See the listed source and full record for attribution limits.

reference.criterion: Human-machine artistic collaborations emerge and receive serious cultural/institutional attention.
reference.rationale: Christie’s 2018 sale of a GAN-assisted work created by a human collective establishes serious institutional attention before 2019. The modest emergence-and-recognition claim was fulfilled. It did not require most artists or leading artists to be machines.

evidence.title: Christie’s: Human-machine art collaboration at auction
evidence.note: Obvious/GAN portrait sold October 2018 for $432,500. Supports serious institutional attention, not majority adoption by artists.. Obvious/GAN portrait sold October 2018 for $432,500. Supports serious institutional attention, not majority adoption by artists.
